content.text: Workspace MFA can be optional today even for roles that can edit production content. Admins in stricter environments need to require MFA for editor and any higher privilege role.

Auth policy setting: minimum_mfa_role = editor | admin | owner | off. Members at or above that role who lack a verified second factor are put into a soft-gate on next session: they can only reach MFA enrollment until complete. API tokens minted before enrollment keep working until expiry but cannot create new long-lived tokens.
Backlog-ready acceptance sketch: grace period option of 0 or 7 days, owner cannot lock themselves out without a recovery code path, and directory-synced users follow the same gate.
